title: Eliminate debt above your expected real return
summary: Same logic as W-2. Threshold: ~6–7% after-tax for personal debt.
detailsHtml:
Business debt nuance

Business debt has two unique considerations for contractors. First, interest on business debt is deductible as a business expense, reducing its after-tax cost. Second, the alternative to paying off business debt is sometimes reinvesting in the business for growth — equipment, marketing, hiring — which can have higher returns than passive investing.

Business loan rate decision: After-tax cost = rate × (1 − combined marginal rate) 9% loan, 24% federal + 15.3% SE tax + 5% state = 44.3% combined After-tax cost: 9% × (1 − 0.443) = ~5% Still likely worth paying down before taxable investing
